get.description:
This function is the last in a series of steps to create a workbookTableRow resource asynchronously. A best practice to create multiple table rows is to batch them in one create tableRow operation and carry out the operation asynchronously. An asynchronous request to create table rows involves the following steps:
1. Issue an async Create tableRow request and get the query URL returned in the Location response header.
2. Use the query URL returned from step 1 to issue the Get workbookOperation request and get the operation ID for step 3. 
    Alternatively, for convenience, after you get a succeeded operationStatus result, you can get the query URL from the resourceLocation property of the workbookOperation returned in the response, and apply the query URL to step 3. 
3. Use the query URL returned from step 2 as the GET request URL for this function tableRowOperationResult. A successful function call returns the new table rows in a workbookTableRow resource. This function doesn't do anything if called independently.

The possible values are: TableStyleLight1 through TableStyleLight21, TableStyleMedium1 through TableStyleMedium28, TableStyleStyleDark1 through TableStyleStyleDark11. A custom user-defined style present in the workbook can also be specified.

columns.description: The list of all the columns in the table. Read-only.

rows.description: The list of all the rows in the table. Read-only.

sort.description: The sorting for the table. Read-only.

worksheet.description: The worksheet containing the current table. Read-only.

index.description: The index of the column within the columns collection of the table. Zero-indexed. Read-only.

name.description: The name of the table column.

values.description: TRepresents the raw values of the specified range. The data returned could be of type string, number, or a Boolean. Cell that contain an error will return the error string.

filter.description: The filter applied to the column. Read-only.

index.description: The index of the row within the rows collection of the table. Zero-based. Read-only.

values.description: The raw values of the specified range. The data returned could be of type string, number, or a Boolean. Any cell that contain an error will return the error string.

fields.description: The list of the current conditions last used to sort the table. Read-only.

matchCase.description: Indicates whether the casing impacted the last sort of the table. Read-only.

method.description: The Chinese character ordering method last used to sort the table. The possible values are: PinYin, StrokeCount. Read-only.

name.description: The display name of the worksheet.

position.description: The zero-based position of the worksheet within the workbook.

visibility.description: The visibility of the worksheet. The possible values are: Visible, Hidden, VeryHidden.

charts.description: The list of charts that are part of the worksheet. Read-only.

names.description: The list of names that are associated with the worksheet. Read-only.

pivotTables.description: The list of piot tables that are part of the worksheet.

protection.description: The sheet protection object for a worksheet. Read-only.

tables.description: The list of tables that are part of the worksheet. Read-only.

protected.description: Indicates whether the worksheet is protected.  Read-only.

color.description: The color applied to the cell.

dynamicCriteria.description: A dynamic formula specified in a custom filter.

filterOn.description: Indicates whether a filter is applied to a column.

icon.description: An icon applied to a cell via conditional formatting.

operator.description: An operator in a cell; for example, =, >, <, <=, or <>.

values.description: The values that appear in the cell.

index.description: The index of the icon in the given set.

set.description: The set that the icon is part of. The possible values are: Invalid, ThreeArrows, ThreeArrowsGray, ThreeFlags, ThreeTrafficLights1, ThreeTrafficLights2, ThreeSigns, ThreeSymbols, ThreeSymbols2, FourArrows, FourArrowsGray, FourRedToBlack, FourRating, FourTrafficLights, FiveArrows, FiveArrowsGray, FiveRating, FiveQuarters, ThreeStars, ThreeTriangles, FiveBoxes.

persistChanges.description: true for persistent session. false for non-persistent session (view mode)

ascending.description: Represents whether the sorting is done in an ascending fashion.

color.description: Represents the color that is the target of the condition if the sorting is on font or cell color.

dataOption.description: Represents additional sorting options for this field. The possible values are: Normal, TextAsNumber.

icon.description: Represents the icon that is the target of the condition if the sorting is on the cell's icon.

key.description: Represents the column (or row, depending on the sort orientation) that the condition is on. Represented as an offset from the first column (or row).

sortOn.description: Represents the type of sorting of this condition. The possible values are: Value, CellColor, FontColor, Icon.

allowAutoFilter.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow the use of the autofilter feature is enabled.

allowDeleteColumns.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow deleting columns is enabled.

allowDeleteRows.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow deleting rows is enabled.

allowFormatCells.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow formatting cells is enabled.

allowFormatColumns.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow formatting columns is enabled.

allowFormatRows.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow formatting rows is enabled.

allowInsertColumns.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow inserting columns is enabled.

allowInsertHyperlinks.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow inserting hyperlinks is enabled.

allowInsertRows.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow inserting rows is enabled.

allowPivotTables.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow the use of the pivot table feature is enabled.

allowSort.description: Indicates whether the worksheet protection option to allow the use of the sort feature is enabled.

request-id.description: Request Id as tracked internally by the service

client-request-id.description: Client request Id as sent by the client application.
